doc: Detector classes (docs/detector-design.md). The order is the class id in exported datasets: append new classes, never reorder or rename one in use. kind is the labeler box kind the class implies. Classes in group minimap are trained on enlarged minimap crops (MINIMAP_CROP in sxs/detect/dataset.py), not on the full frame. Classes in group screen are anchors for model-first state detection (docs/detector-design.md, hybrid). Class item_icon is any catalogued item or currency symbol (resource/items/items.json); the box names which item in "item", and the dataset export can turn each item into its own class (--items each).
